# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Use GitHub's [private security advisory](https://github.com/mindee/bernard-ledit/security/advisories/new) feature to report vulnerabilities confidentially. This ensures the issue can be triaged and patched before any public disclosure.

Please include:
- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce or a minimal proof-of-concept
- Affected versions, if known

We aim to acknowledge reports within **3 business days** and provide a resolution timeline after triage.

## Supported versions

As bernard-ledit is pre-1.0, only the latest release on `main` receives security fixes.
